scope: Internal observations of unchanged candidate oscillator circuits at their retained AC operating points. No historical-device calibration or global stability claim.
findings: Both inspected circuits reproduce their retained external-node operating points and satisfy internal-node reported-current balance.

At the second gate, the modeled high-side output transistor carries negligible collector current while the sink and its base-collector Schottky clamp conduct. Phase and sink transistor intrinsic base-collector voltages are positive.
These are candidate-equation observations, not independent device evidence. Current balance excludes externally loaded output nodes; no unloaded-gate assumption is made for the circuit.
